req.title: Create new player
req.statement: The system shall create a player and respond with HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives a valid Player payload.
expected_outcomes: Location header points to new resource

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 201 on POST /players/ with a valid payload, a Location header pointing to the new resource, and appropriate 4xx/5xx on error paths. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — valid full payload yields 201 + correct Location + response body fields; (2) NEG — missing required field yields 422; (3) NEG — duplicate squad_number yields 409; (4) BVA — squad_number boundary at 0 (invalid domain edge); (5) DT — optional fields absent still yields 201; (6) STC — create then verify resource exists at Location. Each test uses exact-value assertions to kill constant, operator, and boolean mutations.

tests.name: test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location
preconditions: Squad number 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a complete valid PlayerRequestModel payload using squad_number=99
expected: Response body contains id (UUID), firstName='Test', lastName='Player', squadNumber=99, position='Goalkeeper'
trace: R-PLAYER-006: system shall respond HTTP 201 when POST /players/ receives valid payload
R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "middleName": "Mid",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "dateOfBirth": "1990-06-15T00:00:00.000Z",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Test League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert "Location" in r.headers
    assert r.headers["Location"] == "/players/squadnumber/99"
    body = r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["middleName"] == "Mid"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert body["abbrPosition"] == "GK"
    assert body["team"] == "Test FC"
    assert body["league"] == "Test League"
    assert body["starting11"] is True
    assert "id" in body
    import uuid
    uuid.UUID(body["id"])

test_post_player_valid_full_payload_returns_201_with_location()

tests.name: test_post_player_location_header_points_to_retrievable_resource
preconditions: Database pre-loaded with 26 rows; squad_number=77 does not exist
actions: GET the URL from the Location header
expected: GET on Location URL returns HTTP 200
GET response body squadNumber equals 77 and firstName matches posted value
trace: R-PLAYER-006: Location header points to new resource
STC: state transition from non-existent to created and retrievable
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_location_header_points_to_retrievable_resource():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "StateTest",
        "lastName": "Transition",
        "squadNumber": 77,
        "position": "Central Midfield"
    }
    r_post = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    location = r_post.headers["Location"]
    assert location == "/players/squadnumber/77"
    r_get = client.get(location)
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    body = r_get.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 77
    assert body["firstName"] == "StateTest"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Transition"
    assert body["position"] == "Central Midfield"

test_post_player_location_header_points_to_retrievable_resource()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid
client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_post_player_response_body_id_is_valid_uuid():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "UUID",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 88,
        "position": "Attacking Midfield",
        "starting11": False
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    parsed = uuid.UUID(body["id"])
    assert str(parsed) == body["id"]
    assert body["starting11"] is False
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 88

test_post_player_response_body_id_is_valid_uuid()
